name: neosatoshi-card-recognition
description: Identify trading, football and basketball cards in a photo, search and correct them, with Cardmarket prices.
long_description: Lets Claude identify Pokémon, One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Magic: The Gathering, Star Wars: Unlimited, Digimon Card Game, Cyberpunk TCG, Riftbound, football (soccer) and basketball (NBA, EuroLeague) cards in a photo, a binder page or a whole folder, and returns set, number, rarity, Cardmarket product ID and daily prices. It can search the card catalog and correct a wrong card for free. Without an API key it uses the public demo key (10 detections per day per network). It identifies cards; it does not grade condition.

tools.name: recognize_cards
tools.description: Identify the cards in one photo (local file, https link or base64), several cards per photo.

tools.name: recognize_folder
tools.description: Recognize every photo in a folder and write the cards to a new CSV or JSON file there.

tools.name: search_cards
tools.description: Search the card catalog, or a free correction search for a wrong detection.

tools.name: correct_card
tools.description: Correct a detected card to the right one, free within 24 hours.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Get one card by its id, for example to refresh a price.

tools.name: export_cards
tools.description: Export your detections as the same file the NeoSatoshi website exports: custom CSV/JSON, TCGPowerTools, Shopify or eBay CSV. Free.

tools.name: list_export_presets
tools.description: Your saved export presets and the field ids.

api_key.title: NeoSatoshi API key
api_key.description: Optional. Your key from neosatoshi.com, dashboard settings, API keys (any paid plan). Empty: the public demo key, 10 detections per day per network.

allowed_dir.title: Allowed folder
allowed_dir.description: Optional. The only folder (with its subfolders) Claude may read card photos from. Empty: any readable image file.
